exercises.hint: console.log() is the print function in JS

exercises.instruction: Create a constant variable and log it
Create a function that returns the sum of two numbers
exercises.instruction_id: Buat fungsi yang mengembalikan jumlah dua angka
exercises.hint: function keyword declares a named function

exercises.instruction: Use arrow function to multiply two numbers
exercises.instruction_id: Gunakan arrow function untuk kalikan dua angka
exercises.shadow_text:
const multiply = (a, b) => a * b;
console.log(multiply(4, 5));

exercises.instruction: Create an array and use forEach to print elements
exercises.instruction_id: Buat array dan gunakan forEach untuk print elemen
exercises.hint: forEach executes a function for each array element
exercises.hint_id: forEach menjalankan fungsi untuk setiap elemen array

exercises.instruction: Use map to double each number in array
exercises.instruction_id: Gunakan map untuk kalikan dua setiap angka di array
exercises.hint: map returns a NEW array with transformed elements
exercises.hint_id: map mengembalikan array BARU dengan elemen yang ditransformasi

exercises.instruction: Use filter to get even numbers only
exercises.instruction_id: Gunakan filter untuk dapatkan hanya angka genap
exercises.hint: filter keeps elements where callback returns true
exercises.hint_id: filter menyimpan elemen di mana callback mengembalikan true
